apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The wrapper only code-splits DashboardAudienceClient behind a loading shell and owns no network request; a failed chunk load is handled by the Next route error boundary, not by this component.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoRe.empty: The surface renders a fixed six-task demo schedule from module constants and takes no props, so there is no collection that can be empty.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoRe.long-content: All copy and task titles are fixed demo constants with known lengths; no caller supplies content that could run long.
